query:
SELECT 
  pr.id,
  pr.requestNumber,
  pr.urgencyLevel,
  pr.status,
  pr.directorApprovals,
  pr.updatedAt,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ah.step = 'diretoria' AND ah.action = 'aprovada' THEN 1 END) as directorApprovalCount
FROM purchaseRequests pr
LEFT JOIN approvalHistory ah ON ah.requestId = pr.id
WHERE pr.urgencyLevel IN ('urgente', 'emergencial')
  AND pr.status IN ('aguardando_orcamento', 'aguardando_diretoria')
GROUP BY pr.id
HAVING directorApprovalCount > 0
ORDER BY pr.updatedAt DESC;
